summary: This page describes the areas where AfriYouth aims to contribute. Organization-verified results and case studies can be added when approved source material is available.

metrics.label: Evidence & learning
metrics.detail: Generate evidence to understand youth priorities and Africa's socio-economic challenges.

metrics.label: Governance
metrics.detail: Use evidence and youth perspectives to inform policy and public decision-making.

metrics.label: Human-centered solutions
metrics.detail: Bring community needs into the design and development of practical solutions.

metrics.label: Innovation & entrepreneurship
metrics.detail: Advance young people's ideas through innovation and entrepreneurship.

metrics.label: Future readiness
metrics.detail: Consider emerging challenges and opportunities in planning for sustainable development.

pillars.title: Evidence that informs decisions
pillars.description: Research and critical thinking can help young people contribute to informed policy and development decisions.

pillars.title: Ideas shaped into solutions
pillars.description: Human-centered design and entrepreneurship help young people develop ideas in response to community needs.

pillars.title: Youth agency in sustainable development
pillars.description: AfriYouth's mission is to advance young people's innovative ideas for the Sustainable Development Goals in Africa.

methodology.title: Evidence and learning
methodology.description: AfriYouth connects research, policy, human-centered design, entrepreneurship, and foresight. Specific evaluation methods and results should be published with organization-approved sources.
